# `globalJson`

Warns when using JSON.parse or JSON.stringify outside Effect generators instead of Effect Schema

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Effect-native |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377156` |
| Language Service name | `globalJson` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/global-json` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Schema } from "effect"

const User = Schema.Struct({ name: Schema.String })

export const parseUser = (text: string) => Schema.decodeUnknownSync(User)(JSON.parse(text))
/**
                                                                          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(global-json): This code uses `JSON.parse`, which throws instead of failing with a typed error. Use `Schema.fromJsonString(Schema.Unknown)` for unknown shapes, `Schema.fromJsonString(schema)` for known ones, or `Schema.toCodecJson(schema)` when working with JSON values instead of strings.
*/
```

## Language Service Configuration

See the [Language Service setup guide](../../README.md#installation) for installation instructions.

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/schema.json",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "@effect/language-service",
        "diagnosticSeverity": {
          "globalJson": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Oxlint Configuration

See the [Oxlint setup guide](../README.md#oxlint-setup) for installation and patching instructions.

```json
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/oxlint-schema.json",
  "options": {
    "typeAware": true
  },
  "plugins": ["effecttsgo"],
  "rules": {
    "effecttsgo/global-json": "warn"
  }
}
```
